draft_note.default: Draft for review. This text is a starting template for the client and their attorney to review. Items in brackets depend on the tools the final site uses (analytics, form plugin, hosting). It is not legal advice and should not be published without legal review.

td_items.td: Name, company, position, work email, phone number, the type of help you need, and your message
Name, email, phone number, the role you're applying for, your resume, and any note you include

p.default: Like most websites, our hosting provider records basic technical information when you visit, such as your IP address, browser type and the pages you view. [If the final site uses analytics, name the service here, for example Google Analytics, and describe what it collects.]

default.li: To respond to your inquiry and prepare study designs and quotes
To review job applications and contact candidates
To operate, secure and improve the website

p_2.default: We do not sell your personal information, and we do not use it for advertising.

p_3.default: We share information only with service providers who help us run the website and respond to you, such as our website host [Cloudways / DigitalOcean], form provider [form plugin] and email provider, and only for those purposes. We may also disclose information if required by law or to protect our rights.

p_4.default: [Describe cookies once the final site's tools are known. If the site uses only essential cookies, say so. If it uses analytics cookies, explain them and how visitors can opt out.]

p_5.default: We keep inquiry information for as long as needed to respond and to maintain our business records, and job applications for [period] unless you ask us to delete them sooner.

default.p: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information, including encrypted connections (HTTPS) and access controls. No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure.
Please do not send confidential details of your research program through our website forms. We will arrange a confidentiality agreement first.

p_6.default: You can ask us to access, correct or delete the personal information you have sent us by emailing info@alphapreclinical.com. Depending on where you live, you may have additional rights under applicable privacy law. [Attorney to confirm which state laws apply.]

p_7.default: This website is intended for professionals and is not directed to children under 16. We do not knowingly collect information from children.

p_8.default: We may update this policy. The "Last updated" date at the top of the page shows when it last changed.

p_9.default: Questions about this policy can be sent to info@alphapreclinical.com or Alpha Preclinical LLC, 722 Plantation Street, Worcester, MA 01605.
